primary_endpoint: Absolute change from baseline in hepatic fat fraction by MRI-PDFF at Week 12.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 12, hepatic fat fraction changed by -12.32, -13.44, and -14.14 percentage points with EFX 28, 50, and 70 mg, respectively, versus -0.29 with placebo; statistical significance was not reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 1/19 with EFX 28 mg, 0/19 with 50 mg, 1/20 with 70 mg, and 0/21 with placebo; no deaths reported.
